How to use the Parting Hooks - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be showing you how to use the Parting Hooks in Phantom Blade zero. This is an incredibly different weapon from most of the other weapons you've gotten at this point, because it's very, very defensive and actually makes the game a lot more about deflecting attacks and paring attacks than any other weapon up to this point.

How to use the Armybreaker - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this Fextralife video, I'm gonna be showing you guys how to use the Army Breaker. Two-handed weapon. This is probably one of the strongest, if not the strongest weapons I have tested at this point. This thing absolutely dominates the game, and you can absolutely just bully bosses around, including some of the harder bosses in the game.
